name: Cistercian Charter of Charity
summary: Stephen Harding, abbot of Cîteaux, drafts the Carta Caritatis (approved by Callixtus II in 1119), the constitutional document binding all Cistercian houses into a single legal order with annual general chapters, mutual visitation, and a uniform observance of the Rule of Benedict.

_quarry.structural_significance: First medieval religious order with a centralised constitutional structure; the Cistercian model directly influences the constitutional design of the later Dominican and Franciscan orders.
